greet.speaker: Charnel Matriarch
greet.text: Something vast shifts in the dark above, wings folding open. Dozens of smaller shapes stir and wake at the sound.
greet.text_zh: 黑暗中有龐然大物的身影微微移動，雙翼緩緩展開。聲響驚動了周圍數十個較小的身影，紛紛甦醒。

battle_start.speaker: Charnel Matriarch
battle_start.text: It shrieks, and the swarm answers.
battle_start.text_zh: 牠發出尖嘯，蝠群隨之回應。

already_won.text: Only scattered feathers and silence remain where the roost once was.
already_won.text_zh: 曾經的巢穴如今只剩散落的羽毛與一片寂靜。
